Default.note: Bare footer: top hairline, right-aligned rail with ghost Revert and primary Save. Primary Save renders white-on-dark (the dark-surface fix is holding), ghost Revert reads muted.

WithStatus.note: Two footers stacked so the status axis varies: accent 'Unsaved changes' with both buttons live, and success 'Saved 2 minutes ago' with saveDisabled + revertDisabled — the disabled Save is visibly dimmed.

Saving.note: saving=true: Save shows its inline spinner and Revert is disabled by the component's own `revertDisabled || saving`. Info-tone status badge reads clearly.

WithError.note: Error line renders above the rail in destructive ink on its own bordered row, with a destructive 'Not saved' badge beside the buttons. Both optional slots (error + statusLabel) exercised at once.

UnderSettingsRows.note: The footer in its real position — beneath a short stack of SettingsRows — so the shared border-t reads as the divider between the editor body and the save rail rather than a floating line.
